enchantment.rearm.backstep.desc: Press the Action key shortly after shooting an enemy to perform a dash.
enchantment.rearm.crippling_throw.desc: Allows throwing the axe to slow down enemies and recalling it to deal bleeding damage with the Action key.
enchantment.rearm.magic_protection.desc: High resistance to magic damage sources.
enchantment.rearm.bash.desc: Press the Action key while blocking to perform a shield bash, knocking enemies away and dealing minor damage.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: Fires additional arrows in similar directions based on level.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Allows projectiles to pierce through mobs and ignore a percentage of their armor based on level.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Increases the damage and range of sweeping attacks based on level and the amount of enemies hit.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: High resistance to fire, lightning and freeze damage and reduced burn time if you're set ablaze.
enchantment.minecraft.protection.desc: Moderate damage resistance to most close-up physical damage sources.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Allows the weapon to fire normal arrows for free.
enchantment.minecraft.power.desc: Increases the damage of projectiles fired from the weapon.
lore.rearm.netherite_shield: A tool that blocks attacks when used in either hand. This item can be decorated with a banner.
rearm.config.bow.enablePerfectShot.desc: Arrows fired from bows will deal increased damage if they are fired shortly after fully charging the bow. Disables vanilla random arrow critical damage.
rearm.config.bow.enableBackstep.desc: Press the action key shortly after shooting an enemy with a bow enchanted with Quickstep to perform a dash.
rearm.config.bow.improvedMultishot.desc: Changes Multishot to have 3 levels with each level increasing the amount of additional arrows fired.
rearm.config.crossbow.improvedPiercing.d: Allows Piercing to ignore a percentage of the enemies armor based on level.
rearm.config.crossbow.fixedArrowDamage.d: Arrows fired from crossbows will deal consistent damage instead of a variable amount.
rearm.config.sword.enableCriticalCounter: Sword attacks made shortly after blocking with a shield will critically strike. Disables vanilla sword critical strikes.
Increases the damage of the sweeping attack based on the amount of enemies hit and level. Also increases the range of the sweeping attack based on level.
rearm.config.sword.sweepingEdgeAdditiona: Additional damage per mob per level
rearm.config.axe.cripplingThrow.desc: Allows throwing the axe at an enemy like a trident. The axe will remain inside the enemy and slow them. Pressing the action key recalls the axe and the enemy starts taking bleeding damage.
rearm.config.axe.requireLoyaltyForRecall: Require Loyalty for recalling thrown axe
This will also make axes accept Loyalty.
rearm.config.trident.improvedImpaling.de: Makes Impaling also affect all mobs that are in water or rain instead of only specific aquatic mobs.
rearm.config.trident.returnToHand.desc: Tridents with Loyalty will always return to the hand they were thrown from instead of the first free inventory slot.
rearm.config.trident.returnFromVoid.desc: Tridents with Loyalty will return to the player when they enter the Void instead of being destroyed.
rearm.config.shield.enableBash.desc: Allows performing a shield bash by pressing the action key while blocking with a shield, knocking enemies away and dealing minor damage.
rearm.config.shield.enableParry.desc: Raising the shield to block a projectile shortly before it lands parries it and sends it flying towards the shooter.
Changes Protection to only work against physical damage and renames it to Melee Protection.
rearm.config.protection.elementalProtect: Changes Fire Protection to work against lightning and freeze damage on top of fire damage and renames it to Elemental Protection.
Adds a new armor enchantment that protects against magic damage.
rearm.config.protection.normalizeEnchant: When enabled, all protection enchantments obtained from the enchanting table will have similar levels for the same enchanting power.
rearm.config.protection.allowMultiplePro: Allows multiple different types of protection enchantments on the same item.
rearm.config.protection.maxProtectionEnc: Set the maximum allowed amount of different protection types on the same item.
rearm.config.armor.armorMultiplier.desc: Increases the max armor limit by this multiplier. For example, if the multiplier is 2, max armor will be 40 instead of 20, and all armor values will be automatically adjusted.
rearm.config.armor.helmetArmorPercent.de: The percentage of the total armor the helmet piece should have. The helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots percentages need to add up to 100, if not, the percentages will revert to default values.
rearm.config.armor.chestplateArmorPercen: The percentage of the total armor the chestplate piece should have. The helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots percentages need to add up to 100, if not, the percentages will revert to default values.
The percentage of the total armor the leggings piece should have. The helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots percentages need to add up to 100, if not, the percentages will revert to default values.
rearm.config.armor.bootsArmorPercent.des: The percentage of the total armor the boots piece should have. The helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots percentages need to add up to 100, if not, the percentages will revert to default values.
rearm.config.armor.bodyArmorPercent.desc: The percentage of the total armor the body piece should have. This affects horse and wolf armor for example.
rearm.config.armor.totalArmorOverrides.d: By default, the mod will automatically rescale armor values on all armor in the game using the default total armor gained from the set. Total armor can be overridden here for any material type. See file config/rearm/armor_materials.txt for a list of currently available armor materials.
rearm.config.armor.armorMaterialList: These are all the armor materials for which you can override the total defense value by adding them to the "Total armor overrides" setting inside the mod configuration.
rearm.config.armor.enchantmentBasedTough: When enabled, toughness on armor will depend on the type and the amount of protection enchantments on the armor. All armor will also have their base toughness removed.
rearm.config.armor.defenseBasedKnockback: When enabled, knockback resistance on armor will depend on the defense of the armor. This gives knockback resistance to armors besides netherite.
rearm.config.tweaks.improvedSneaking.des: Greatly reduces the range at which mobs can detect you while sneaking.
rearm.config.tweaks.detectionRangeReduct: How much the detection range is decreased while sneaking. Vanilla is 20%.
rearm.config.tweaks.craftTippedArrowsWit: Changes the tipped arrow recipe to use regular potions instead of lingering ones.
rearm.config.tweaks.infinityFix.desc: Makes bows and crossbows enchanted with Infinity not require having an arrow in the inventory.
rearm.config.tweaks.hideDisabledItemsFro: Hide disabled items from recipe viewers
rearm.config.bugFixes.dragonBreathDamage: MC-84595: "Roasted in dragon's breath" death message does not appear when player is killed by dragon's breath
rearm.config.bugFixes.enderDragonVelocit:
MC-272431: Ender Dragon incorrect vertical velocity causes erratic behavior
MC-197201: The Ender Dragon does not dive toward the player (missing "diving" attack)
rearm.config.bugFixes.powerDamageFix.des: MC-277617: The base damage of the Power enchantment was reduced in 1.21
